candidate_evidence.quote: TN-TC11G (THC+CBD) Combination With Temozolomide and Radiotherapy in Patients With Newly-diagnosed Glioblastoma
Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD) have shown a clear synergistic antitumour effect with temozolomide and radiotherapy in preclinical glioma models.

coder_notes: TN-TC11G is a fixed-dose 1:1 THC:CBD product, split into dronabinol (INN for delta-9-THC) and cannabidiol rows with fixed_dose_combination true; as the only investigational product each component is experimental_monotherapy (R3). Licensing status of TN-TC11G is not stated in the record (lookup to resolve). Primary outcome text mentions 'Glasdegib', apparently a registry copy error; glasdegib is not a registered intervention and is not listed. Midkine in blood is a response correlate, not stated as pharmacodynamic for the cannabinoids, so target_engagement_planned coded no (alternatively unclear). Enzyme-inducing antiepileptics mentioned only in exclusion criteria.
